links.outcome: Effect of knowledge graph and RAG grounding on record understanding, antibiotic recommendation accuracy, and safety
links.effect: KG-LLM vs Llama-2 baseline: F1 0.914 vs 0.867, Top-1 dose-drug-duration accuracy 0.782 vs 0.716, unsafe antibiotic suggestions reduced by 50%; ablation shows KG and RAG each contribute substantially.
links.quote: Ablation analyses indicate that the knowledge graph, RAG, and safety modules each contribute substantially to clinical reliability and interpretability.
